resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, facial profile, and visible profile eye clearly readable. The second camera direction is the measured axis. Obey its literal crop, side view, field of view, asymmetric placement, and negative-space counterweight. Create a clean hand-drawn two-dimensional editorial illustration. The exact name-free signature controls the visible medium, face, eyes, silhouette, palette, light, composition, and ornament. Make these eight cues bold and unmistakable: line language—bold broken dry-brush contours with visible gaps around the entire silhouette and seams; face design—a firm jaw and planar cheeks; eye design—large layered irises and paired catchlights; body design—broad shoulders and athletic stable limbs; palette language—clay, sand, olive, cream, and warm brown fields; light modeling—broad visible painterly light and shadow masses; framing language—a centered emblem-like outer border around the canvas, expressed in the background while the measured camera controls subject placement; ornament language—a visible field of drifting particles. Draw face and eye details crisply within the mid-thigh figure. Put the ornament on both the garment and outer border. Keep the visible figure in front of every decorative framing element. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: Photograph an adult subject using head-and-shoulders framing with breathing room around the hair and neckline from a rear three-quarter camera position with the face still readable through a natural turn. The view uses long-lens compression with flattened depth and carefully separated silhouette edges and diagonal depth flow that leads from a quiet foreground anchor toward the face. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—use an eye-level mid-thigh inspection frame with the lower edge visibly intersecting both thighs and the complete crown, both eyes, shoulders, and visible hand gestures inside while the knees, calves, shoes, and feet continue beyond the canvas.
